instruction.text: Match the definitions with the correct type of data.

atoms.a: a type of data that is measurable and expressed in number form
a type of data that represents groups, labels or categories

instruction.text: Decide whether the statistical question will be answered by using numerical or categorical data.

wrong.text:
Numerical data is measurable and expressed in number form.
Examples: height, size or age.

Categorical data is represented by words, labels or categories.
Examples: gender, eye colour or favourite food.

atoms.a: How many pets do the families in your neighbourhood have?
How much does a pretzel cost in New York City?
What’s the average shoe size of a 12-year-old?
What’s the most popular ice cream flavour?
What’s the most common blood type among students in your class?
What’s the most common eye colour in Oxford?
What’s the most common zodiac sign in your class?
